mapper.sql: c.id, c.book_id, c.owner_author_id, c.collaborator_author_id, u.username, a.pen_name, c.role, c.can_edit_book, c.can_publish_book, c.can_manage_chapters, c.can_publish_chapters, c.can_manage_story, c.can_view_analytics, c.version, c.created_by_author_id, c.updated_by_author_id, c.create_time, c.update_time

CASE WHEN b.author_id = #{actorAuthorId} THEN 'OWNER' ELSE c.role END AS collaborationRole, CASE WHEN b.author_id = #{actorAuthorId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ownerAccess, CASE WHEN b.author_id = #{actorAuthorId} THEN 1 ELSE c.can_edit_book END AS canEditBook, CASE WHEN b.author_id = #{actorAuthorId} THEN 1 ELSE c.can_publish_book END AS canPublishBook, CASE WHEN b.author_id = #{actorAuthorId} THEN 1 ELSE c.can_manage_chapters END AS canManageChapters, CASE WHEN b.author_id = #{actorAuthorId} THEN 1 ELSE c.can_publish_chapters END AS canPublishChapters, CASE WHEN b.author_id = #{actorAuthorId} THEN 1 ELSE c.can_manage_story END AS canManageStory, CASE WHEN b.author_id = #{actorAuthorId} THEN 1 ELSE c.can_view_analytics END AS canViewAnalytics
mapper.select: SELECT b.id AS book_id, b.author_id AS owner_author_id, #{actorAuthorId} AS actor_author_id, CASE WHEN b.author_id = #{actorAuthorId} THEN 'OWNER' ELSE c.role END AS collaboration_role, CASE WHEN b.author_id = #{actorAuthorId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_owner, CASE WHEN b.author_id = #{actorAuthorId} THEN 1 ELSE c.can_edit_book END AS can_edit_book, CASE WHEN b.author_id = #{actorAuthorId} THEN 1 ELSE c.can_publish_book END AS can_publish_book, CASE WHEN b.author_id = #{actorAuthorId} THEN 1 ELSE c.can_manage_chapters END AS can_manage_chapters, CASE WHEN b.author_id = #{actorAuthorId} THEN 1 ELSE c.can_publish_chapters END AS can_publish_chapters, CASE WHEN b.author_id = #{actorAuthorId} THEN 1 ELSE c.can_manage_story END AS can_manage_story, CASE WHEN b.author_id = #{actorAuthorId} THEN 1 ELSE c.can_view_analytics END AS can_view_analytics FROM book b LEFT JOIN author_book_collaborator c ON c.book_id = b.id AND c.collaborator_author_id = #{actorAuthorId} WHERE b.id = #{bookId} AND (b.author_id = #{actorAuthorId} OR c.id IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 1

SELECT b.id, b.book_name, b.pic_url, b.cat_name, b.visit_count, b.yesterday_buy, b.last_index_update_time, b.update_time, b.word_count, b.last_index_name, b.status, b.author_id,
FROM book b LEFT JOIN author_book_collaborator c ON c.book_id = b.id AND c.collaborator_author_id = #{actorAuthorId} WHERE b.author_id = #{actorAuthorId} OR c.id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY b.create_time DESC

SELECT b.id, b.book_name, b.author_id,
FROM book b LEFT JOIN author_book_collaborator c ON c.book_id = b.id AND c.collaborator_author_id = #{actorAuthorId} WHERE b.author_id = #{actorAuthorId} OR (c.id IS NOT NULL AND c.can_manage_chapters = 1) ORDER BY b.create_time DESC

SELECT a.id AS author_id, a.user_id, u.username, a.pen_name FROM author a JOIN user u ON u.id = a.user_id WHERE (u.username = #{identity} OR a.tel_phone = #{identity}) AND COALESCE(a.status, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(u.status, 0) = 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN u.username = #{identity} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, a.id

SELECT FROM author_book_collaborator c JOIN author a ON a.id = c.collaborator_author_id JOIN user u ON u.id = a.user_id WHERE c.book_id = #{bookId} AND c.owner_author_id = #{ownerAuthorId} ORDER BY c.create_time, c.id

SELECT FROM author_book_collaborator c JOIN author a ON a.id = c.collaborator_author_id JOIN user u ON u.id = a.user_id WHERE c.book_id = #{bookId} AND c.collaborator_author_id = #{collaboratorAuthorId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO author_book_collaborator (book_id, owner_author_id, collaborator_author_id, role, can_edit_book, can_publish_book, can_manage_chapters, can_publish_chapters, can_manage_story, can_view_analytics, version, created_by_author_id, updated_by_author_id) VALUES (#{bookId}, #{ownerAuthorId}, #{collaboratorAuthorId}, #{role}, #{canEditBook}, #{canPublishBook}, #{canManageChapters}, #{canPublishChapters}, #{canManageStory}, #{canViewAnalytics}, 0, #{createdByAuthorId}, #{updatedByAuthorId})
mapper.update: UPDATE author_book_collaborator SET role = #{row.role}, can_edit_book = #{row.canEditBook}, can_publish_book = #{row.canPublishBook}, can_manage_chapters = #{row.canManageChapters}, can_publish_chapters = #{row.canPublishChapters}, can_manage_story = #{row.canManageStory}, can_view_analytics = #{row.canViewAnalytics}, updated_by_author_id = #{actorAuthorId}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{row.id} AND book_id = #{row.bookId} AND owner_author_id = #{row.ownerAuthorId} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO author_book_collaborator_audit (collaborator_record_id, book_id, owner_author_id, collaborator_author_id, event_type, role, can_edit_book, can_publish_book, can_manage_chapters, can_publish_chapters, can_manage_story, can_view_analytics, version, actor_author_id) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.bookId}, #{row.ownerAuthorId}, #{row.collaboratorAuthorId}, #{eventType}, #{row.role}, #{row.canEditBook}, #{row.canPublishBook}, #{row.canManageChapters}, #{row.canPublishChapters}, #{row.canManageStory}, #{row.canViewAnalytics}, #{row.version}, #{actorAuthorId})
